adjudication.rationale: In app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb, `poll_feed` parses the feed and unconditionally does `rss.items.each do |i| ... TopicEmbed.import(...) end` with no cap/batching. `TopicEmbed.import` performs DB lookups (`TopicEmbed.where(embed_url: url).first`), and may create/revise posts via `PostCreator`/`PostRevisor`, so a large feed could make this scheduled job run for a long time and tie up a worker. This is a diff-grounded performance/operational concern rather than a correctness defect.
